Compact plan represents each source occupancy and complete SAP history at that checkpoint, and is rebuilt if source changes
All destination occupied flags, vector headers and live pointer storage initialized before access; pointer tails zeroed/rebound using actual source body base

reviewed_properties: Body-index distinctness and point-count guards precede local bindings.
Per-contact RAII commits preserve complete partial velocity/position/rotation/matrix writes on every early numeric/trig return.
Normal and tangent contact anchor reuse consumes unchanged bodyR/localanchor bits, only after successful normal pass.
Contact/island/iteration order, zero-iteration behavior and position-convergence stop are unchanged.
Original solver.hpp SHA matches generated headers source pins; no original arithmetic/check/store graph rewritten.

limitations: Large fixed-prefix fanout; no universal/single-game speed or score claim.
Best mode uses six checked CPU future-prefix ticks once; GPU work counts exclude the original CPU100-tick prefix and separate qualification replays/continuations.
Contact capacity512 retains explicit rejection outside admitted workloads.
Selected semantic comparison ignores only existing-contract inactive payload and live ABI padding; raw persisted checkpoints are guarded byte-for-byte.
Hardware stall counters remain unavailable; static resources and controlled A/B results do not prove a stall cause.
The broad per-world memory layout remains unchanged; further large kernel gains need a separate structural redesign.
